plan.title: Reject proposal submission with empty Procurement Type

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the named Vendor B.
Verify the line item and vendor allocation was selected before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocation.

args.goal: fill every required proposal field except Procurement Type, click Submit Proposal, and stop with Procurement Type highlighted as required

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving Procurement Type empty, then attempt submission.
Assert that submission is refused because Procurement Type is required.
